goal: Prevent untrusted inputs like RPC method names or wallet names from injecting fake lines into debug.log
Stop restricted RPC users from forging log messages to mislead node operators or monitoring tools
agreement: Unaddressed objection: wallet names can still inject fake log lines via startup warnings (w0xlt)
Suggests dropping the line-splitting commit to eliminate the remaining injection vector (ryanofsky)
Support for global newline escaping across RPC and external daemon inputs (davidgumberg, ryanofsky)
Verified by testing RPC injection prevention and wallet name handling (polespinasa)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it prevents untrusted inputs from forging arbitrary fake log entries in debug.log
Protects node operators and automated monitoring tools from misleading errors or false alarms
